text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
To give Zephyr-san courage... I definitely 
want to win the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can truly be of any help 
to Zephyr-san. Still, I know firsthand 
just how happy it makes you when someone 
cheers you on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If nothing else, I hope my cheers reach 
her. Zephyr-san... so cool, always doing 
her best for someone else... I hope it 
reaches you!
